messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Study 1 was a 72-week trial comparing Zepbound weight loss with placebo in adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition, excluding patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:
Treatment dose | Average % weight loss | Average weight lost | Average starting weight

Zepbound 10 mg | 19.5% | 45.5 lb | 233.2 lb
Zepbound 15 mg | 20.9% | 48.6 lb | 232.8 lb
Placebo | 3.1% | 7.2 lb | 231.0 lb
Triplet: ["Zepbound Study 1", "has duration", "72 weeks"]

The relation 'has duration' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject study lasts for the specified length of time.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
B. 'has half life': The subject drug remains in the body for the duration specified by the object entity.
C. 'has prolonged duration in': In individuals with the specified condition, the duration of the subject drug's presence in the body is extended.
D. 'takes 6 to 8 weeks to relieve': The subject drug requires a period of 6 to 8 weeks to fully alleviate the condition specified by the object entity.
